ss
Don't we need spdm requester/responder role as a config here? or it's planned for later changes?
This schema is created only for responder.
Requester will also have similar configuration. While we can read title to understand role, programmatically we will need fixed type to consume
What is the utility of the “name” property here?

It's to create the object path for the exposes record.

Since the schema is top-level (listed in `exposes_record.json`)
`Name` is needed to form the object path.

The requirement is also encoded in the schema file itself

https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/blob/ee867a631897fce5443e59f321dae8043125fbdf/schemas/exposes_record.json#L178
Is there a way to just inherit from it then and not duplicate this information?
You want to use the satellite controller here?

I believe Patrick is referring to a general schema related topic here (duplication of listing common required properties on each schema).

Which is an overarching concern and not specifically a problem with this patch.

Therefore closing this discussion thread, kindly re-open it if i misunderstood anything.
We have the problem as it is a generic SPDM endpoint, Endpoint discovered through MCTP doesn't require that
What is type of object?

`Type` and `Name` are properties required on any toplevel configuration record in EM. EM uses `Name` to create the object path and `Type` to create the DBus interface name for the configuration record.

So the property is required here.


Some people fill out `description` field for consistency reason, if that's what you meant.
Done
Will have to define TrustedComponentType in entity manager configuration, since SPDM Spec does not define whether root of trust is discrete or integrated?
Done
I don't see the required association for the SPDM D-Bus object here. How is the association expected to be populated in the SPDM daemon
Association changes will be taken as part of another commit.
Can you please share the commit if it's already part of chain. It will help to review both the changes for the complete solution.

@archana.kakani@ibm.com I think once association discussion concluded here https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/83263/comment/f2022daa_e3c50f86/

we can add the association here as well.

@hosmanechinmay@gmail.com @spinler@us.ibm.com - Current schema provides requester/responder configuration. Associations are required for redfish enablement. Associations should not block the spdm daemon work for discovery and such. We do not have inventory model ready for our next system and might take some time. I can get back to association once we have something that can be testable in our environment.
Can we get this in ? and later I can create another patch for adding the association support.

I think since this is a schema it's better to define now and in json file for the initial patches we can skip and implement it later.
@ratankgupta31@gmail.com Any thoughts?
This commit has been under review for nearly three months. We can merge this basic schema for now and address the necessary association-related changes in subsequent patches.
This is the root of trust inventory object and it is protecting to some inventory, It could be self or it could be protecting to some other entity, we need to define that association too.
Association changes will be taken as part of another commit.
Can you push that commit too?
Based on comment https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/82112/comment/97b92031_183e0904/ this can be changed to SpdmTcpEndpoint
Done
Hostname and Port is specific to TCP protocol which is not required for MCTP protocol.

Since schema file name `spdm_endpoint.json` is generic and multiple endpoints like mctp requester, tcp requester can be defined separately since each will have it's own specific properties. Also definition should be changed to `SpdmTCPEndpoint` instead of `SpdmEndpoint`.
Acknowledged
